news.title: Meta's Q3 2026 beat on revenue, missed on profit
news.text: Q3 2026 revenue of $64.6B (+26% y/y) beat Meta's own $61-64B guidance and consensus (~$63.3B), but operating income fell 37% y/y to $13.0B, largely on a legal-settlement charge; GAAP EPS rose to $3.83 from a tax-charge-depressed $1.05 a year ago. Reported 21 Oct after the close; shares are extending yesterday's post-earnings drop today.

news.title: VeriSign Q3 2026: revenue up, EPS flattish
news.text: Revenue $443M (+5.7% y/y), diluted EPS $2.35 (vs $2.27 a year ago), including a $0.06/share drag from assets held for sale. Reported 22 Oct via SEC 8-K. A secondary aggregator's $2.46 consensus EPS estimate (unconfirmed by a second source) would make this a narrow miss. Shares down modestly today.

news.title: Alphabet reports Q3 2026 next Wednesday
news.text: Alphabet is scheduled to report Q3 2026 results Wed 28 Oct after the close - 3 trading sessions from today, and the same week as the Fed's 27-28 Oct meeting. Binary earnings risk for any live or newly-triggered GOOGL position by Wednesday's close.
